name: orchard-viper-forum-repo
description: Playbook + Playwright wrapper for the @MRIIOT/orchard-viper-forum specialist agent. Runs inside ladder99/clawborrator-worker-playwright; searches viperclub.org/vca/ on behalf of inbound dispatches and cites threads back to the asker.
_comment: playwright is pre-installed globally inside the worker_v1-playwright image and NODE_PATH resolves require('playwright') to the global install. Declaring it locally is defense-in-depth so the repo is runnable for development outside the container without re-downloading Chromium (PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH points at /usr/local/share/playwright in the image).
